title: Find Nearest Right Node in Binary Tree
summary: Given a binary tree's root and a node u, identify the nearest node on the same level that is to the right of u, or return null if u is the rightmost node in its level.
statement: Given a binary tree's root and a node u, identify the nearest node on the same level that is to the right of u, or return null if u is the rightmost node in its level.
constraints: Tree values are unique and u is a node in root.
Return the node immediately to the right of u on the same depth, or None if u is last.
